name: Marren Tobacco Tax Act

components.cap_unit: dollars per pack of 20, not indexed
source_sentences: Licensed stamping agents (wholesalers), who buy tax stamps and affix them before sale to retailers, must pay a cigarette tax raised from $1.50 to $3.50 per pack of 20, fixed in money terms (not indexed).
Other tobacco products (roll-your-own tobacco, cigars, "little cigars") stay at 25% of the wholesale price.
The bill was introduced in June, passage was expected from early August, it was signed on 1 October, and it took effect on 1 January.
About 45% of Marren's population lives within a 20-minute drive of Dunmarch or of Kessick, its southern neighbor.
Of the revenue from the $2.00 increase, $0.30 per pack goes to the Tobacco Unit and to the existing quit-smoking program (already funded from general revenue); the rest goes to the general fund.

unclear.text: Whether the use tax on cartons above the allowance will be collected at all in practice.
